newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton ends higher but shy of resistance.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton ends higher but shy of resistance.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures settled firmer and just under the day's highs after a see-saw session took benchmark July to a recent high before pressuring the contract back below unchanged.
Trading sources said options-related buying and local short-covering fueled July, while the trade remained a steady scale-up seller.
The funds are expected to emerge as major buyers once July pierces resistance at the recent high of 73.75 cents a lb, a dealer said.
July finished 0.35 cent higher at 73.56 cents after trading from 73.65 to 73.05 cents. New-crop December closed up 0.29 cent at 75.61 cents, while the rest ended 0.32 to 0.15 cent firmer.
An estimated 12,000 lots changed hands on the day, compared with Wednesday's official 7,915 lots.
Analysts said today's gains reflect optimism about Friday's export and sales numbers. USDA will issue its report at 0830 EDT.
